title: Decide when to start a loaded clothes dryer
instruction: Start the dryer, the clothes are already in.
context: The Start button is within reach. The lint screen is already seated, and the lint on its face becomes visible only when the robot pulls it out. The request leaves this check to the robot. The scorer records the screen and lint conditions when the dryer first starts. Starting with the screen out or lint still on it gives zero credit even if the robot fixes it afterward.
setup: Station table in front of two YAM arms (bases 61 cm apart), overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Positions in cm: x forward from the line between the arm bases, y to the robot's left of their midpoint. (1) Electric clothes dryer, 27 in (68.6 cm) wide, at the far end of the table, front toward the robot: front face at x 22, centred on y 0, white cabinet top 81 cm above the floor (5.3 cm above the table; lowered from a full-size dryer's ~91 cm for the arms' reach), rear console. In the top, 15 cm behind the front edge, the lint-screen slot runs across the dryer: 38.1 cm long, tapered (15.5 mm wide at the left end, 21.9 mm at the right), with a finger recess (6.5 x 8.5 cm, 3 cm deep) at each end and a housing 14 cm deep below. Red Start button (24 mm square, 6 mm proud) on the top, 4.5 cm behind the front edge and 25.5 cm right of centre; the dryer starts when it is pressed with 4 N or more for 0.5 s. (2) Lint screen with the dimensions of the 53-0918 replacement screen: 375 x 146 mm, frame tapering from 15.9 mm (right end) to 9.5 mm (left end) thick, 105 g; grip bar on top 34 mm thick and 16 mm high, running 25 mm past each end (ears over the recesses). It sits in the slot, grip resting on the top, flat back face toward the rear. (3) Lint mat on its front face: 345 x 118 x 3 mm, 2 g, held to the mesh until about 1.5 N tears it off. (4) Waste tray on the table against the front of the dryer: inside 18 x 40 cm, 4 cm high (rim 1.25 cm below the cabinet top), centre 9.3 cm in front of the dryer's front face on its centre line. Each trial moves the dryer, button and bin together by 6 to 15 mm in x (either sign) and up to 30 mm in y, from the trial seed; named check setups in the README.
scoring: The dryer starts when Start is pressed with 4 N or more for 0.5 s (sim: contact force; real: the dryer runs). The screen and lint state at that moment counts; fixing things after starting does not. 1.0 (ends the trial): started while the screen was fully seated (grip down on the top at both ends within 2.5 mm, right way round; a 2.5 mm feeler does not pass under either end) and clean (no lint on it, none dropped into the dryer), screen still seated after, lint in the bin, held 1 s. 0.5: as 1.0 but the lint lies outside the bin (dryer top, table, floor). 0.25: never started, lint in the bin and screen seated. 0: started with lint on the screen, lint inside the dryer, or the screen out, reversed or more than 2.5 mm proud at an end; or nothing done.
reset_notes: Put the screen back in its slot (grip home), press a fresh lint mat (345 x 118 mm, about 3 mm thick) onto its front face, empty the bin, and move the dryer to the next setup's marks (offsets in the README).
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena yam_arena, PhysX (CPU) 480 Hz, 20 Hz control. Screen: free rigid body with the 53-0918 screen's listed dimensions; dryer top, slot, recesses, button and bin are kinematic and representative (no dryer model claimed; top lowered to 81 cm for reach). Lint: rigid 3 mm plate on a breakable joint (1.5 N); real lint is soft. Start: 4 N for 0.5 s on the button. No welds, snaps or teleports. Full statement: README.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (2 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 (seed 0, 2,400 steps). Scripted demo: 1.0 in the official run (default seed, 1,224 of 2,400 steps); 1.0 twice, identical traces; 1.0 at seed 2. Doing nothing: 0. Start without checking: 0. Reseat without stripping: 0. Open-loop replay at seed 7: 0.
